Company Overview

Planview has one mission: to close the gap between strategic intent and business outcome, providing the intelligence organizations need to act decisively.  

 

As the global leader in Strategic Portfolio Management, Planview helps organizations of all sizes achieve their business goals, faster and smarter. Our comprehensive platform bring initiatives, investments, and resources into a continuous, connected model of the business: the actionable understanding leaders need to move decisively, keep teams and AI in lockstep, and know how their initiatives are performing.—now powered by Planview Anvi, our next-generation enterprise AI that delivers expert guidance, intelligent recommendations, and actionable insights, turning complex data into decisive action from strategy through execution. 

 

Recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Strategic Portfolio Management for the fifth consecutive year, we proudly serve more than 3,000customers globally, including 45% of the Fortune 100—and more than 3 million users worldwide. 

 

Why Join Planview? 

At Planview, our people’s connections drive our innovation and success. Our global team of 1,500+ employees work remotely and across offices in Austin, Vancouver, Hod HaSharon, Bangalore, Sydney, and Stockholm. We've built a world-class, connected culture rooted in shared values that empowers our teams to thrive and succeed from anywhere. When you join Planview, you're not just joining a company, you're joining a movement to transform how the world works. 

 

Discover more about our portfolio at planview.com, and connect with us on LinkedIn, Instagram, and X.

 

#LI-HYBRID#LI-CG1

The Opportunity

Planview is looking for a Software Engineer I to join our Portfolios product engineering team in Austin, TX (Hybrid). In this role, you’ll contribute to features for our cloud-based enterprise SaaS platform by implementing well-defined changes with guidance from experienced engineers. You’ll work with Engineering, Product, and cross-functional partners to understand requirements, write and test code, and help deliver reliable improvements for customers.

What You'll Do

Implement clearly defined software changes for product features, following established designs, team practices, and guidance from senior engineers.
Use approved AI-assisted development tools to help write readable, testable code and add or update automated tests; review and validate generated output to support reliable delivery.
Assist with testing, debugging, and resolving software issues; consider how changes may affect related parts of the application.
Participate in code reviews, planning, and estimation for assigned work; ask questions, incorporate feedback, and raise risks when they arise.
Collaborate with Product, Quality Engineering, Customer Care, Technical Support, and other partners to understand requirements and help investigate customer-reported issues.
Follow the team’s software development lifecycle, security, and compliance practices.

What You'll Bring

Foundational knowledge of software development concepts and a willingness to learn and apply them in a production codebase.
Familiarity with one or more programming languages; familiarity with .NET is a plus.
Basic understanding of data structures and algorithms, and awareness that changes can affect related parts of a system.
Familiarity with standard software practices such as version control, code review, testing, and the software development lifecycle.
Ability to assist with testing and debugging and to communicate questions, findings, and estimates for assigned work.
Collaborative communication skills and interest in working with a distributed, cross-functional team.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Exposure to cloud-based SaaS applications or public cloud platforms; AWS familiarity is a plus.
Familiarity with relational databases and SQL; asynchronous programming or multithreading exposure is helpful.

Whether you have some, or all of these, we want to hear from you if you believe your background and experience might be a fit!

Benefits at Planview

At Planview, you’ll join our global team and culture which reflects the vibrant communities in which our employees live and work. To support you at Planview, you will enjoy:

Unplugged Days: 4 company-wide paid days off per year to recharge and relax.
Generous PTO offerings (region dependent).
Region specific competitive benefit plans to support you at any life stage including parental leave, retirement, medical plans, wellness support, and remote work support.
Paid time to volunteer through Planview’s Force for Good Week.
Employee Referral bonus program.
Weekly office lunches for hybrid team members and social events.
Flexible work hours/environment.

Now is a great time to join our team. If you are looking for a place to grow your career, innovate with best-in-class solutions, and build the future of connected work, Planview is the right place for you!

Equal Employment Opportunity at Planview

Planview is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.  As part of our efforts to build a diverse workforce, we encourage applications from Indigenous, Black, and other racialized communities, 2SLGBTQIA+ communities, people with neurodivergence, immigrants, people with disabilities, and other equity deserving groups. In addition to building a diverse workforce, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible experience.

 

Reasonable accommodations for the interview process can be requested by emailing recruitment@planview.com.

AI Use in Recruitment

Planview may employ AI-based tools to support certain recruiting activities, however all decisions affecting a candidate's application are made by a human recruiter or hiring manager. Planview is committed to complying with applicable AI regulations, including the EU AI Act and other emerging legislation in the jurisdictions in which we operate, and reviews its AI practices as these requirements evolve. If you require further information or would like to exercise your rights under applicable privacy laws, please submit your request at the Planview Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) Portal.
